over: One parameterised reusable workflow for both deployments
because: Two short workflows that read alike are easier to audit than a reusable workflow with inputs, and the one contract test keeps them from drifting (spec #28 D9, ticket #46)

over: Ignore the edit without recording it
because: Without the revision, a reactivation before the pending recheck let the superseded content give kudos (R21, R24, R31; ship review of #70)

chose: The welcome DM and App Home's views.publish go through the delivery path in convex/slack/delivery.ts (tryAtMostThreeTimes, sendOnce): at most 3 tries on any error, the per-method Retry-After hold, gone answers stop
over: Keep the welcome's own 3-attempt loop and publish App Home once
because: #38 and #44 built the same bounded delivery twice; the welcome ignored holds and gone answers and lost its DM when building the text threw, and App Home stayed blank after one failed lookup or publish because its receipt suppresses redelivery (ship review of #70; supersedes the #44 follow-up)

chose: Count is_archived, not_reactable and invalid_name as gone: the delivery stops for good
over: Cap indicator attempts at a fixed number
because: These answers mean the reaction can never show on that message (archived channel, unreactable message, deleted emoji); R35's until it shows would otherwise retry hourly forever. A cap would also give up on passing failures R35 wants retried (ship review of #70)
